what_this_is: CLEAN START (captain, 2026-10-02): the recorded demo leads are REMOVED. The office's lead file (Relationships → Sales pipeline) starts empty.

The pipeline screen (app/(staff)/staff/pipeline) reads this file through lib/api-client/crm-leads.ts. crm-families (leads, pipeline, customer sync, lead assignment) is unbuilt — docs/02-architecture/microservices.md — so no service response is being recorded here; the reader is strict, and an empty file renders the screen's honest empty state.

The office's live prospect lifecycle runs on the shared agent journal instead: an enquiry converted on the Inquiries board is recorded by lib/api-client/agent-store.ts and folded onto the Prospects screen and the agent pipeline (lib/api-client/agent.ts).
When a lead/customer-records contract freezes, this file is replaced by recorded contract fixtures and lib/api-client/crm-leads.ts gains the live branch.
stages: The PRD pipeline stages (commerce-catalog §33), the same vocabulary the agent record renders: new → contacted → qualified → presentation → proposal → reserved → sold.
